content.text: Heading "מדריך" says "כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה", which is what I came for. Scrolling on.

content.thinking: ה"כסף שוטף וקצר" נגלל לי לפני שקראתי, ורק "ריבית" נתפס; קרן השתלמות כבר יש לי, ואת שורת הפנסיה ואת "לילדים" אני מדלג עליהם.
Titles of the "לבחירה עצמית" cards were cut off by the scroll, so I'm working from the visible fragments, and I'm noting that "מדד S&P 500" is the one my friends mention.

content.text:
I sort of get it now. Every saving has two parts. One is where the money sits, like a bank deposit, a קרן השתלמות, a קופת גמל להשקעה or an investment account. The other is what it's invested in, like a money market fund, the S&P 500 or the Tel Aviv indexes. So I'd look at three things: the קרן השתלמות I already have, the קופת גמל להשקעה (apparently you can take the money out any time, and I always thought it was for old people), and some investment account, with the S&P 500 inside. I'm only fairly sure. The page never says which one is better for me, says nothing about fees, and never tells me what to do first.

**How it went:**
- **Screen 1:** The heading "מדריך … כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה" was exactly my question. Then the "שני חלקים בכל חיסכון" section, which is what made it click. Under "מאיפה להתחיל" there were three links: קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן כספית.
- **Screen 2:** The page jumped. I only saw the bottoms of the "כסף שוטף וקצר" cards, so I don't know which ones they were. Under "חיסכון עם הטבת מס" I read the cards for קרן השתלמות and קופת גמל להשקעה. I skipped the "פרישה" and "לילדים" sections.
- **Screen 3:** Same thing again with "לבחירה עצמית". The card titles were cut off and I only saw bits of text, so I never found out what to actually open. That's exactly the part I'd need. Under "במה הכסף מושקע" I stopped at S&P 500.
- **Screen 4:** More index cards, then "מה האתר עוד לא מכסה" and the footer. I didn't read the grey text at the bottom.
- **Words I didn't get:** מק"מ, אג"ח, "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו", קרן חדשה כללית, תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים, מסלול כללי. I'm also not sure what "יומית / מתחדשת" means on the קרן כספית card.
- **What bothered me:** no fees in shekels, no picture of what 30,000 ₪ would actually grow into, and no "start here if you're like you". There are about 20 cards that all look the same. I'd have closed it around screen 3.
